title: Reading marks on a carton liner
titleZh: 判讀紙箱內襯上的痕跡

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: During today’s transport trial, we heard a carton rattle. The sound alone doesn’t tell us which way the unit moved. Check the paper liner for rub marks beside the unit’s feet. A mark running toward an end panel points to movement along the length of the carton. A mark running toward a side panel points across its width. This sample has marks toward an end panel. For the next test, narrow the gap only between the pads on that pair of panels.
turns.zh: 今天做運送測試時，聽到一個試樣紙箱裡有晃動聲。光靠聲音無法判斷產品往哪個方向移動。檢查紙內襯，在產品腳座旁找摩擦痕。痕跡朝端板延伸，表示產品沿箱體縱向移動；朝側板延伸，表示橫向移動。這件樣品的痕跡朝端板延伸。下次測試時，只要縮小那一對板面上兩個墊塊的間距。
